title: River Beal Takeaway in Milnrow crowned best in North West at Euro Asia Curry Awards
excerpt: River Beal Takeaway has been awarded the title of best takeaway in the North West at the Euro Asia Curry Awards 2026, reflecting its quality and regional reputation.
body:
River Beal Takeaway in Milnrow has been recognised as the best takeaway in the North West at the prestigious Euro Asia Curry Awards 2026, announced during a gala event on a Monday night in November.

The award highlights the takeaway's commitment to quality food and its strong reputation in a competitive culinary market. River Beal Takeaway has won two awards this year, further establishing its status in the region.

The owners of River Beal Takeaway expressed pride in their achievement, noting that the recognition reflects their dedication to providing excellent service and food quality.

The Euro Asia Curry Awards celebrate the best in the culinary field across the UK, and River Beal's win is part of a national recognition of outstanding takeaways.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version stated a fact that the source reports differently. The article now reflects what Oldham Times reports.
